what: `switchboard roadmap units` writes a create-queue batch with one issue per node that has none; `switchboard roadmap wire` sets native blocked-by links from each node's after list.
expectations: A node that already has an open or closed issue carrying its node:<id> label gets no second issue.
Each generated issue carries exactly one node:<id> label, one type label and its feature label.
After wire, every after id is a native blocked-by link; running wire twice changes nothing.
